text: Marketing is an interdisciplinary field that studies how enterprises identify and meet consumers' needs, and achieve the goals of brand value and profitability through strategic activities. It integrates knowledge from various fields such as economics, psychology, sociology, and management. The core principle is "consumer-centeredness". Through precise market analysis, creative communication strategies, and efficient channel management, it builds a bridge between enterprises and users. In the digital age, marketing has evolved from the traditional "selling products" to "building user relationships", becoming the core driving force for enterprise growth.
